purpose: Independent practice of B2.2 and B2.1.
student_learning_goal: I can recall multiplication facts of 2, 5, and 10 and write the related division facts.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can recall multiplication facts of 2, 5, and 10 and write the related division facts.
header.character_watermark: Maya the Multiplication Maven in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. A 12-cell fluency table in a 4x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A 12-cell fluency table in B&W line-art, 4-row × 3-column grid. Facts: 2×7, 2×9, 5×6, 5×8, 10×4, 10×7, 2×5, 5×9, 10×6, 2×8, 5×3, 10×9.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_FLUENCY_TABLE: keywords (fluency, facts) name what the table shows.

parts.student_instructions: Each triangle holds a fact family. Write all four facts (or three for doubles).
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Six fact-family triangles in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Six fact-family triangles in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column grid. Each ~1.6in tall. Numbers: T1 (2,7,14), T2 (5,6,30), T3 (10,4,40), T4 (5,5,25 — doubles), T5 (2,8,16), T6 (10,7,70). Below each: equation lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_SIX_TRIANGLES: keywords (triangles, facts) name what the triangles show.

parts.student_instructions: For each division fact, write the related multiplication.

image_placeholders.description: Six rows in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 0.6in. Format: division fact on left (e.g., 18÷2=___), arrow, related multiplication slot. Facts: 18÷2, 35÷5, 80÷10, 14÷7, 30÷6, 60÷10.
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; six rows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_SIX_PAIRS: keywords (division, multiplication) name what the rows ask for.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write 3 fact families of your own with ×2, ×5, or ×10.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Use Part 1 fluency for diagnostic data. Watch for Part 2 children who write only 2 facts per triangle.
